about: HyperFrames' pull-request ingest, as shipped (11/10/2026, user OK). Run by `kit.py ingest <film> <owner/repo#N | PR url>` (engine/kit.py, Node.js and a logged-in gh): fetch-pr.mjs -> 01_Brief/pr/ (pr.json, diff.patch), ingest.mjs -> 01_Brief/pr/extracted/ (people.json, visible-text.txt, tokens.json), fetch-people-avatars.mjs -> 03_HTML/assets/<login>.png. kit.py checks these hashes (LF line ends) before every run.
